scientific_definition_of_events.heuristic_nature: Temporal gap clustering (>20.0s) is an operational anti-leakage grouping mechanism to guarantee that adjacent frames of the same vehicle ingress sequence are placed in the same split.
scientific_definition_of_events.physical_identity_distinction: This heuristic does NOT represent ground-truth vehicle re-identification. Closely tailgating trucks (<20s) may be grouped into one event, while a slow truck (>20s) could be split into two. True vehicle identity is established solely through human ground truth annotation.
